plain_description.what: Splits the 598 paired frontier matches from ARENA-13 by which answer each reference supports. It then separates the +7.9-point gap into a part caused by the reference agreeing with a contestant and a remaining part. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: Tests whether ARENA-13's apparent judge self-preference is real or just the reference siding with one contestant.
plain_description.information: A large remaining part would mean genuine self-preference. A remaining part near zero would mean the reference's agreement leaks into the verdict. Result: the claim was amended. Reference agreement explains all of the gap, and no self-preference is left. As a by-product, on 299 matches with byte-identical prompts the judge still disagreed with itself 5.7% of the time. That is the judge's repeat-noise floor. This test belongs to the older question pool, so it now counts as history, not evidence.
